method.savePolicy: Preserve existing BKVince characters and stashes whenever possible; stop for an explicit decision before an unavoidable reset.
method.multiplayerPolicy: Validate solo first; host/joiner remains mandatory before a lot is fully delivered.
method.sequence: Complete the governed audit before opening stable implementation lots.
method.implementationBoundary: This catalog records evidence and candidate dispositions only; it does not authorize bulk copying or gameplay table changes.

chapters.title: Game Mechanics foundation and engine contracts
General changes, quality of life, and balance
Item bases, affixes, crafting, and concepts
Hardcoded behavior, AI, pointmods, and native routes

entries.title: Expanded storage and inventory layout
entries.playerEffect: Expands practical storage and inventory usability.
entries.rationale: Decision closed on 2026-08-08: keep BKVince. Its larger storage and charm-inventory identity already exceed PD2 coverage, so a PD2 merge would regress or conflict.

entries.title: Stackable materials and consumables
entries.playerEffect: Reduces stash friction by stacking common progression materials.
entries.rationale: Decision closed on 2026-08-08: keep BKVince. The relevant stacking families already exist, so preserve their established codes, counters, recipes, and save compatibility.

entries.title: PD2 core solo NoDrop baseline
entries.playerEffect: Raises solo drop quantity through PD2 Treasure Class weights without increasing monster difficulty.
entries.rationale: The official page attributes the p5-like solo baseline to PD2 core, and the two published NoDrop examples reproduce exactly from the PD2 table weights while BKVince reproduces the LoD values. Adaptation is data-only but still requires a complete BKVince economy baseline and statistical validation.

entries.title: High-level and corrupted-zone progression
entries.playerEffect: Broadens viable endgame farming areas and reward bands.
entries.rationale: BKVince already has rifts, terror-zone work, and corruptions, so PD2 zone concepts need integration into that ecosystem.

entries.title: Class skill pointmods and staffmods
entries.playerEffect: Changes which class skills can naturally roll on class-specific equipment.
entries.rationale: D2R 3.2 staffmod generation may combine table rules with native logic; the active BKVince staffmod test must settle the route.

entries.title: Weapon, armor, and miscellaneous base rebalance
entries.playerEffect: Makes more base items competitive through damage, defense, speed, and requirement changes.
entries.rationale: The tables expose the changes, but values must be retuned around BKVince itemization and existing saves.

entries.title: Rare-item affix quality floor
entries.playerEffect: Reduces low-value affix outcomes on rare items at higher levels.
entries.rationale: Affix eligibility is data-driven, but enforcing a per-rare floor may require native selection logic.

entries.title: Expanded deterministic crafting recipes
entries.playerEffect: Adds more useful sinks, upgrades, rerolls, and deterministic crafting paths.
entries.rationale: The large recipe delta is directly auditable, but recipes must be selected to fit the BKVince economy.

entries.title: Mercenary skill and aura kits
entries.playerEffect: Gives mercenary variants distinct combat roles, auras, and progression.
entries.rationale: Candidate kits must be reconciled with the active Act I Rogue and ExtendedMerc workstreams.

entries.title: Mercenary targeting and positioning AI
entries.playerEffect: Improves mercenary engagement, positioning, and skill choice.
entries.rationale: The tables describe AI assignments and parameters but do not prove the runtime decision logic.

entries.title: Act IV mercenary concept
entries.playerEffect: Adds a new mercenary archetype with a distinct equipment and skill identity.
entries.rationale: A new hireling type crosses data, UI, serialization, and runtime assumptions and cannot be treated as a table-only port.

entries.title: Class-specific skill rebalance
entries.playerEffect: Changes class build viability, synergies, scaling, and mechanical identity.
entries.rationale: BKVince has its own Warlock and skill ecosystem; only isolated concepts should be evaluated class by class.

entries.title: Monster curse, aura, and resistance rebalance
entries.playerEffect: Rebalances dangerous monster modifiers and reduces binary resistance checks.
entries.rationale: The audit proves the PD2 Aura pool, targeted slow guards and resistance interactions; values and flags are data-visible, while aura selection and several Prime rules require native ownership and BKVince endgame tests.

entries.title: Boss loot and repeat-kill identity
entries.playerEffect: Makes campaign and endgame bosses more consistently rewarding.
entries.rationale: The audit resolves the requested boss TC graphs, quest/non-quest branches, six-drop cap, essences and p1 probabilities; any merge remains an economy decision tied to BKVince progression and corruption systems.

entries.title: Delayed undead-doll death explosion
entries.playerEffect: Telegraphs the lethal doll explosion and gives the player a reaction window.
entries.rationale: Core S13 data proves death-skill 363, DollMeteor radius 4, Range 25 and fixed damage; the 25-frame execution, D2R 3.2 handler ordinals, authority and corpse ownership remain an inherited-semantic inference requiring native proof.

entries.title: Quiver rarity and progression tiers
entries.playerEffect: Turns arrow and bolt supplies into an itemization slot with meaningful progression.
entries.rationale: The concept is table-driven, but compatibility with existing quivers and BKVince item codes must be audited.

entries.title: Single Player Plus orb and conversion economy
entries.playerEffect: Adds solo-oriented currency sinks and conversion shortcuts.
entries.rationale: Useful solo conveniences are candidates, but their rates must not bypass BKVince progression.

entries.title: Single Player Plus accelerated drop rates
entries.playerEffect: Accelerates access to rare, set, unique, and crafting rewards in solo play.
entries.rationale: This is a separate solo-economy overlay, not the PD2 core p5-like NoDrop foundation. Direct transplantation would stack with BKVince's own rune and linear-MF choices; any future review belongs to an isolated economy lot.

entries.title: Socket and item-state preservation recipes
entries.playerEffect: Lets selected cube operations preserve sockets or other valuable item state.
entries.rationale: Cube output syntax may cover part of the behavior, but serialization and state-copy semantics require proof.
